section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Axle Shock Absorber
title: REMOVAL OF FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER ASSEMBLY

content.description: Illustration showing disconnection of brake tube from flexible hose using SST (Special Service Tool)

items.heading: DISCONNECT BRAKE TUBE
items.text: Using SST and an open end wrench, disconnect the brake tube from the flexible hose. Drain the brake fluid into a container.

content.description: Illustration showing three nuts on top of shock absorber mount
Illustration showing removal of two bolts mounting shock absorber assembly to steering knuckle arm

items.heading: REMOVE TWO BOLTS
items.text: Remove the two bolts mounting the shock absorber assembly to the steering knuckle arm.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of front shock absorber, front axle hub and brake caliper, with 5mm measurement indicated for collar depth in steering knuckle bolt holes

items.heading: REMOVE FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER, FRONT AXLE HUB AND BRAKE CALIPER
items.text: Push the suspension lower arm down and remove the front shock absorber, front axle hub and brake caliper.

content.text: Collars in steering knuckle bolt holes about 5 mm (0.20 in.) deep.

content.description: Illustration showing front shock absorber mounted in vise or locking plate (SST)

items.heading: MOUNT FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER IN VISE OR LOCKING PLATE (SST)
